# We Contribute to Feeding Our World

The Simplot Company’s Purpose to Contribute to Feeding Our World drives our commitment to global
food and agriculture. Our diverse portfolio spans from the soil and the sea to dinner tables around
the world, and the agriculture-related interests in between.

We pioneer innovations in plant nutrition and food processing, research new ways to feed animals and
sustain ecosystems and strive to feed a growing global population. Our diverse portfolio across
global agriculture and food gives us a broader view of the entire food system unique to any other
company.

[About Simplot][113]
[Career Opportunities][114]
Sustainability

## Our Responsibilities

Our passion for people starts with a strong commitment to our employees and communities. We are
dedicated to ensuring our employees enjoy equal opportunities, a safe and healthy work environment
and are treated with fairness, respect and dignity. We are also tenacious in making sure all of our
global operations function safely, efficiently and securely.

[Learn More][115]

About Us

## The Simplot Company

The Simplot Company began to take shape in the farm fields of southern Idaho in the late 1920s.
Still privately held and headquartered in Boise, Idaho, Simplot has grown into an international
agribusiness company that operates in more than 60 countries with more than 18,000 employees
worldwide. J.R. Simplot began his colorful career in 1923, near the small farming community of
Declo, Idaho, when he quit school to go into business on his own. **He was only 14 years old**.

## Последние проекты

[
Проект

##### Правильное питание как основа здорового образа жизни

Проект посвящён изучению влияния правильного питания на формирование и поддержание здорового образа
жизни. В работе рассматриваются ключевые принципы рационального питания, их влияние на здоровье и
функциональную активность органов и систем организма. Анализируются пищевые привычки студентов
медицинских вузов для выявления основных тенденций и проблем в питании молодежи. На основе
полученных данных предлагаются рекомендации, направленные на формирование здоровых пищевых привычек
и поддержание функционального баланса организма. Работа подчёркивает важность комплексного подхода к
здоровью, объединяющего правильное питание и образ жизни, что способствует профилактике заболеваний
и повышению качества жизни.
][10][
Проект

##### Воскресная школа для взрослых: современные подходы и методики катехизации

Проект посвящен исследованию современных методов и подходов к катехизации взрослых в контексте
воскресных школ, сочетая традиционные церковные практики оглашения с инновационными образовательными
технологиями. Особое внимание уделяется обмену опытом между духовенством и ответственными лицами, а
также духовной поддержке слушателей в процессе подготовки к таинствам. Цель проекта — развитие
эффективных методик обучения взрослых, способствующих глубокому усвоению христианской веры в
современных условиях. Проект включает создание обучающих материалов и организацию площадок для
совместного обмена опытом.
][11][
Проект

##### Применение нейрографики для психологической поддержки детей в условиях воздушных тревог и
##### военной ситуации

Данный проект исследует эффективность метода нейрографики как арт-терапии для психологической
поддержки детей в условиях постоянных воздушных тревог и использования дронов в зоне специальной
военной операции. Проект направлен на анализ влияния стрессовых факторов на психику детей и
разработку коррекционных методик с применением нейрографики для снижения уровня тревожности,
улучшения эмоционального состояния и адаптации к неблагоприятным условиям. В исследовании
рассматриваются особенности работы с детьми с особыми образовательными потребностями в инклюзивной
среде, а также применение творческих техник арт-терапии для развития интеллектуальных и
эмоциональных ресурсов у детей.
][12][
Проект

##### Современные подходы и методики катехизации в воскресной школе для взрослых

Проект посвящён разработке и анализу современных методик катехизации в воскресных школах для
взрослых. Используя опыт протоиерея Сергия Стаценко, основное внимание уделяется комплексному
использованию огласительных бесед, приходского консультирования и внебогослужебных форм общения для
формирования прочной духовной общины и эффективного усвоения православной веры. Проект охватывает

##### Правильное питание как основа здорового образа жизни

жизни. В работе рассматриваются ключевые принципы рационального питания, их влияние на здоровье и
функциональную активность органов и систем организма. Анализируются пищевые привычки студентов

и поддержание функционального баланса организма. Работа подчёркивает важность комплексного подхода к
здоровью, объединяющего правильное питание и образ жизни, что способствует профилактике заболеваний

эффективных методик обучения взрослых, способствующих глубокому усвоению христианской веры в
современных условиях. Проект включает создание обучающих материалов и организацию площадок для
совместного обмена опытом.

улучшения эмоционального состояния и адаптации к неблагоприятным условиям. В исследовании
рассматриваются особенности работы с детьми с особыми образовательными потребностями в инклюзивной
среде, а также применение творческих техник арт-терапии для развития интеллектуальных и
эмоциональных ресурсов у детей.

и повышению качества жизни.

воскресных школ, сочетая традиционные церковные практики оглашения с инновационными образовательными

современных условиях. Проект включает создание обучающих материалов и организацию площадок для
совместного обмена опытом.

##### Применение нейрографики для психологической поддержки детей в условиях воздушных тревог и
##### военной ситуации

Данный проект исследует эффективность метода нейрографики как арт-терапии для психологической
поддержки детей в условиях постоянных воздушных тревог и использования дронов в зоне специальной
военной операции. Проект направлен на анализ влияния стрессовых факторов на психику детей и
разработку коррекционных методик с применением нейрографики для снижения уровня тревожности,
улучшения эмоционального состояния и адаптации к неблагоприятным условиям. В исследовании
рассматриваются особенности работы с детьми с особыми образовательными потребностями в инклюзивной
среде, а также применение творческих техник арт-терапии для развития интеллектуальных и
эмоциональных ресурсов у детей.

формирования прочной духовной общины и эффективного усвоения православной веры. Проект охватывает
систематизацию педагогических методов, их адаптацию к нуждам прихожан, а также практические
рекомендации для реализации образовательного процесса на приходском уровне.

##### Натюрморт в искусстве Нидерландов XVII века: роль и особенности

Проект исследует жанр натюрморта в искусстве Нидерландов XVII века, выделенный как самостоятельное
направление в постренессансный период. Анализируются виды голландских натюрмортов, включая цветочные
композиции, "учёные", "кухонные" натюрморты и "накрытые столы", а также монохромные "завтраки" с их
особенностями световоздушной среды и колорита. Особое внимание уделяется художникам "малых
голландцев" и их вкладу в развитие жанра, исследуется символизм, детализация и технические приемы
изображения света и цвета. Работа позволяет осмыслить исторический контекст и художественную
значимость натюрморта в XVII веке.

возраста в период 2019-2024 годов. В рамках проекта рассматриваются ключевые трудности формирования

является систематизация знаний и разработка рекомендаций для оптимизации сенсорного развития
малышей.

## About Us

DT Food Machine A Reliable Food Machine Manufacturer and Integrated  Solution Provider in Food
Processing Industry

DT food machine is a professional food machine manufacturer and food processing solution provider in
China. We are located in Henan Province which is main Chinese comprehensive transportation hub,
logistic and information flow center. With population over 100 million, Henan Province is among the
China’s largest agriculturalmand grain processing province. These provides rich support and
conditions for DT Food Machine factory to emerge, develope and leads the food processing industry. 

30 Years ago, we started flour mill plant and food processing equipment factory to serve domestic
market demand. To catch up with diversification of processed food varieties both domestic and
abroad, we continue to develop new equipment and enhance the overall food processing solutions for
food factories. At present, the main food processing solution is baking processing, noodle
production line, fruit and vegetable processing line, nut production line. And processing technology
involves cleaning, frying, baking, quick-freezing, etc. Until Now, we have export our food machines
to over 180 countries and regions worldwide.

So far, DT factory covers an area of 50000m2 including Food technology laboratory, raw material
processing workshop, equipment assembly workshop, equipment debugging workshop, equipment packaging
workshop, equipment storage and delivery workshop.

## About Us

DT Food Machine A Reliable Food Machine Manufacturer and Integrated  Solution Provider in Food
Processing Industry

DT food machine is a professional food machine manufacturer and food processing solution provider in
China. We are located in Henan Province which is main Chinese comprehensive transportation hub,
logistic and information flow center. With population over 100 million, Henan Province is among the
China’s largest agriculturalmand grain processing province. These provides rich support and
conditions for DT Food Machine factory to emerge, develope and leads the food processing industry. 

30 Years ago, we started flour mill plant and food processing equipment factory to serve domestic
market demand. To catch up with diversification of processed food varieties both domestic and
abroad, we continue to develop new equipment and enhance the overall food processing solutions for
food factories. At present, the main food processing solution is baking processing, noodle
production line, fruit and vegetable processing line, nut production line. And processing technology
involves cleaning, frying, baking, quick-freezing, etc. Until Now, we have export our food machines
to over 180 countries and regions worldwide.

So far, DT factory covers an area of 50000m2 including Food technology laboratory, raw material
processing workshop, equipment assembly workshop, equipment debugging workshop, equipment packaging
workshop, equipment storage and delivery workshop.

## Karriere bei der Emsland Group

Die Emsland Group kombiniert die Bodenständigkeit eines lokalen Unternehmens mit der weltweiten
Vermarktung einer internationalen, mittelständischen Unternehmensgruppe. Wir bieten an sieben
Produktionsstandorten in Deutschland und mit über 120 Repräsentanzen weltweit bemerkenswerte
Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Entwicklung. Unsere Einstiegsmöglichkeiten reichen vom Praktikum über
diverse Ausbildungsplätze und Stellenangebote in der Grafschaft Bentheim und weit darüber hinaus. 

[ Mehr erfahren ][41]

## Über uns

Seit über 90 Jahren produzieren wir für einen weltweiten Markt Qualitätsprodukte, „Made in Germany“.
Aus dem nachhaltigen Rohstoff der Kartoffel und Erbse optimieren wir Produkte des täglichen Lebens.
Wir sind Spezialist für Stärkeveredlungsprodukte, Kartoffelflocken und
-granulate, Proteine wie auch Fasern.

## Karriere bei der Emsland Group

Die Emsland Group kombiniert die Bodenständigkeit eines lokalen Unternehmens mit der weltweiten
Vermarktung einer internationalen, mittelständischen Unternehmensgruppe. Wir bieten an sieben
Produktionsstandorten in Deutschland und mit über 120 Repräsentanzen weltweit bemerkenswerte
Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Entwicklung. Unsere Einstiegsmöglichkeiten reichen vom Praktikum über
diverse Ausbildungsplätze und Stellenangebote in der Grafschaft Bentheim und weit darüber hinaus. 

[ Mehr erfahren ][41]

## Über uns

Seit über 90 Jahren produzieren wir für einen weltweiten Markt Qualitätsprodukte, „Made in Germany“.
Aus dem nachhaltigen Rohstoff der Kartoffel und Erbse optimieren wir Produkte des täglichen Lebens.
Wir sind Spezialist für Stärkeveredlungsprodukte, Kartoffelflocken und
-granulate, Proteine wie auch Fasern.

[ Mehr erfahren ][42]

## Unsere Lieferanten

Eine enge und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Landwirten ebenso wie mit unseren

der Emsland-Service GmbH in unsere Unternehmensgruppe der Emsland Group.

# About Fanidhar Mega Food Park

**Fanidhar Mega Food Park Private Limited** – As an SPV, **Fanidhar Mega Food Park** complies with
the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India, and Government of Gujarat scheme
standards. Scattered across 52.68 acres lies the Mega Food Park, which specializes in high-quality
**bulk potato flakes for export** and is a trusted **potato flakes exporter in India**.

## Technology

At Fanidhar Mega Food Park Pvt. Ltd., we take pride in being a leading Potato Flakes Manufacturer in
India, delivering consistent quality and efficiency through our state-of-the-art technology. Our
dehydrated potato flakes are processed to meet strict global standards, ensuring superior taste and
reliability for diverse food applications. We are registered under the Ministry of Food Processing
Industries, Government of India, and benefit from the Government of Gujarat’s Mega Food Park
Scheme—affirming our commitment to manufacturing excellence, innovation, and sustainable food
processing.

[ Learn more about our technology ][23]

## Our Products

Potato flakes are made from freshly cooked, mashed potatoes that are carefully dehydrated to
preserve their natural taste and nutrition. They are light, convenient, and versatile—perfect for
preparing instant mashed potatoes, snacks, soups, and bakery items. 

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Fanidhar Mega Food Park known for?

Fanidhar Mega Food Park is a leading food processing hub in Gujarat, offering advanced facilities
for food manufacturers, including potato flakes production and exports.

What are dehydrated potato flakes used for?

Dehydrated potato flakes are widely used in mashed potatoes, soups, snacks, bakery products, and
instant foods due to their long shelf life and easy rehydration.

Can I buy dehydrated potatoes in bulk from India?

Yes, Fanidhar Mega Food Park offers bulk supplies of dehydrated potatoes, catering to exporters,
food processors, and international buyers.

Can I buy bulk potato flakes for export from India?

Yes, bulk potato flakes are available for export from certified suppliers at Fanidhar Mega Food
Park, ensuring international quality standards.

Why choose a potato flakes exporter from India?

Indian potato flakes exporters provide cost-effective, high-quality products with reliable global
supply chains and customized packaging options.

How to contact manufacturers and exporters of dehydrated potatoes in India?

You can contact Fanidhar Mega Food Park directly via their official website or customer support to
inquire about products, pricing, and export options.

## Get In Touch With Us

**We’d love to connect with you.** Whether you’re looking for product details, technical
specifications, bulk orders, or collaboration opportunities, our team is here to assist you.

# About Fanidhar Mega Food Park

**Fanidhar Mega Food Park Private Limited** – As an SPV, **Fanidhar Mega Food Park** complies with
the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India, and Government of Gujarat scheme
standards. Scattered across 52.68 acres lies the Mega Food Park, which specializes in high-quality
**bulk potato flakes for export** and is a trusted **potato flakes exporter in India**.

## Technology

At Fanidhar Mega Food Park Pvt. Ltd., we take pride in being a leading Potato Flakes Manufacturer in
India, delivering consistent quality and efficiency through our state-of-the-art technology. Our
dehydrated potato flakes are processed to meet strict global standards, ensuring superior taste and
reliability for diverse food applications. We are registered under the Ministry of Food Processing
Industries, Government of India, and benefit from the Government of Gujarat’s Mega Food Park
Scheme—affirming our commitment to manufacturing excellence, innovation, and sustainable food
processing.

[ Learn more about our technology ][23]

## Our Products

Potato flakes are made from freshly cooked, mashed potatoes that are carefully dehydrated to
preserve their natural taste and nutrition. They are light, convenient, and versatile—perfect for
preparing instant mashed potatoes, snacks, soups, and bakery items. 

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Fanidhar Mega Food Park known for?

Fanidhar Mega Food Park is a leading food processing hub in Gujarat, offering advanced facilities
for food manufacturers, including potato flakes production and exports.

What are dehydrated potato flakes used for?

Dehydrated potato flakes are widely used in mashed potatoes, soups, snacks, bakery products, and
instant foods due to their long shelf life and easy rehydration.

Can I buy dehydrated potatoes in bulk from India?

Yes, Fanidhar Mega Food Park offers bulk supplies of dehydrated potatoes, catering to exporters,
food processors, and international buyers.

Can I buy bulk potato flakes for export from India?

Yes, bulk potato flakes are available for export from certified suppliers at Fanidhar Mega Food
Park, ensuring international quality standards.

Why choose a potato flakes exporter from India?

Indian potato flakes exporters provide cost-effective, high-quality products with reliable global
supply chains and customized packaging options.

How to contact manufacturers and exporters of dehydrated potatoes in India?

You can contact Fanidhar Mega Food Park directly via their official website or customer support to
inquire about products, pricing, and export options.

## Get In Touch With Us

**We’d love to connect with you.** Whether you’re looking for product details, technical
specifications, bulk orders, or collaboration opportunities, our team is here to assist you.

Sustainability

At FreshTime, our commitment to sustainability is more than just a practice; it's a responsibility
we hold dear. Our sustainability efforts encompass every facet of our operations, from sourcing to
production and beyond. 


Transparency & Traceability

We firmly believe that our clients deserve complete transparency about the products they receive.
Our supply chain is built on traceability, enabling our clients to have full confidence in the
quality, safety, and sustainability of the ingredients that go into their products.

Advanced Sorting Technology

Complementing our visual inspection, we employ advanced sorting technology that utilizes optical
sensors, cameras. and sophisticated algorithms. These high-tech systems can detect imperfections and
inconsistencies that may not be visible to human .

Quality Control& Testing

At every stage of production, from cutting to dehydration, we employ stringent quality checks to
ensure that only the highest-quality slices meet our standards. Samples of our dehydrated vegetables
undergo laboratory testing to confirm food safety, quality, and adherence to industry standards.


Audits and inspections

Regular audits and inspections, conducted by authorized bodies, confirm our steadfast adherence to
food safety regulations and standards.

We conduct audits of our suppliers to ensure that the raw materials we source meet the stringent
quality and safety criteria we demand.


Certified

We are proud to hold a comprehensive range of internationally recognized certifications, a testament
to our unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability.

Here’s a brief overview of the different fryer types you mentioned.

[** Fully Automatic Potato Chips Line**][32]:-  This production line is designed to automate the
entire process of producing potato chips, including steam peeling, slicing, frying, seasoning, and
packaging.

[**Frozen French Fries Production Line**][33]:– A frozen french fries production line typically
involves machinery and equipment for washing, steam peeling, cutting, blanching, drying, frying,
freezing, and packaging french fries for long-term storage.

[**Fully Automatic Pellets Frying Line**][34]:-  This type of frying line is used for processing and
frying pellets, which are popular snack items made from ingredients such as potato, corn, or rice.

[**Automatic Namkeen Fryer**][35]:-  An automatic namkeen fryer is specifically designed for frying
namkeen, a variety of traditional Indian snacks like as sev, bhujiya, gathiya, papdi, etc.  It
ensures consistent frying and can be automated for increased efficiency.

[** All Types of Batch Fryer**][36]:-  Batch fryers are versatile fryers that can be used for frying
a wide range of snacks. They typically offer flexibility in terms of batch sizes and can accommodate
different types of snacks.

Here’s a brief overview of the different fryer types you mentioned.

[** Fully Automatic Potato Chips Line**][32]:-  This production line is designed to automate the
entire process of producing potato chips, including steam peeling, slicing, frying, seasoning, and
packaging.

[**Frozen French Fries Production Line**][33]:– A frozen french fries production line typically
involves machinery and equipment for washing, steam peeling, cutting, blanching, drying, frying,
freezing, and packaging french fries for long-term storage.

[**Fully Automatic Pellets Frying Line**][34]:-  This type of frying line is used for processing and
frying pellets, which are popular snack items made from ingredients such as potato, corn, or rice.

[**Automatic Namkeen Fryer**][35]:-  An automatic namkeen fryer is specifically designed for frying
namkeen, a variety of traditional Indian snacks like as sev, bhujiya, gathiya, papdi, etc.  It
ensures consistent frying and can be automated for increased efficiency.

[** All Types of Batch Fryer**][36]:-  Batch fryers are versatile fryers that can be used for frying
a wide range of snacks. They typically offer flexibility in terms of batch sizes and can accommodate
different types of snacks.

### **Our Story.**

Idaho Pacific Holdings, Inc. is a family of potato dehydration companies spanning North America –
from the nutrient rich farmlands of Idaho to the San Luis Valley of Colorado to the red sandy soils
of Prince Edward Island, Canada. Our factories are situated in prime potato producing areas because
that is where it all begins. We manufacture potato products for the world using the best raw
potatoes in North America.

Our Company began in 1987 in the farming community of Ririe, Idaho, which today remains our Company
headquarters. Over the past 35 years we have grown from our roots in Ririe, Idaho to being one of
the largest potato dehydration companies in North America consisting of four manufacturing
facilities. Our manufacturing facilities utilize state-of-the-art equipment and processes which
allow the ability to produce a wide variety of dehydrated potato products. Our highly talented team
is ready to provide the technical know-how to support our customers’ needs.

Potatoes, whether eaten fresh, frozen or dehydrated, are the #1 consumed vegetable in North America.
We are proud to be an integral part of the potato industry supporting the farmers in our local
communities, the foodservice operations serving school lunches, cafeterias, nursing homes and
restaurants, and food manufacturers that utilize our ingredients to make a wide array of delicious
products. The versatile potato with its nutritious attributes has many applications and we stand
ready to assist you in your current dehydrated potato needs and to help you innovate the products
for tomorrow.

# **Start Fresh.

[ Learn more ][42]
 
 

### **Our Story.**

Idaho Pacific Holdings, Inc. is a family of potato dehydration companies spanning North America –
from the nutrient rich farmlands of Idaho to the San Luis Valley of Colorado to the red sandy soils
of Prince Edward Island, Canada. Our factories are situated in prime potato producing areas because
that is where it all begins. We manufacture potato products for the world using the best raw
potatoes in North America.

Our Company began in 1987 in the farming community of Ririe, Idaho, which today remains our Company
headquarters. Over the past 35 years we have grown from our roots in Ririe, Idaho to being one of
the largest potato dehydration companies in North America consisting of four manufacturing
facilities. Our manufacturing facilities utilize state-of-the-art equipment and processes which
allow the ability to produce a wide variety of dehydrated potato products. Our highly talented team
is ready to provide the technical know-how to support our customers’ needs.

Potatoes, whether eaten fresh, frozen or dehydrated, are the #1 consumed vegetable in North America.
We are proud to be an integral part of the potato industry supporting the farmers in our local
communities, the foodservice operations serving school lunches, cafeterias, nursing homes and
restaurants, and food manufacturers that utilize our ingredients to make a wide array of delicious
products. The versatile potato with its nutritious attributes has many applications and we stand
ready to assist you in your current dehydrated potato needs and to help you innovate the products
for tomorrow.

IndianPotato.com is India's only intelligence platform for the potato industry. We provide live

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is IndianPotato.com?+

IndianPotato.com is India's only intelligence platform for the potato industry. We provide live
mandi prices, industry news, company directory, state reports, variety database, and market
intelligence for farmers, traders, processors, and exporters.

How do I check today's potato price?+

Visit our Mandi Prices page for live wholesale rates from 30+ Indian mandis including Agra, Azadpur,
Ahmedabad, Deesa, Indore, Patna, and Jalandhar. Prices are updated daily by the IndianPotato
Intelligence Team.

How do I list my company in the directory?+

Visit the Directory page and click "Get Listed". Silver listings start at ₹499/year. Premium and
Platinum tiers offer enhanced visibility with full profile pages, lead generation, and contact
features.

Is IndianPotato.com free to use?+

Yes. All articles, mandi prices, variety guides, state reports, and job listings are free to access.
Premium services like market intelligence reports (from ₹999/month) and directory listings (from
₹499/year) are available for businesses.

# BUILT TO LEAD

[ Discover what we do best ][20]
WE SHAPE YOUR FUTURE
IN POTATO PROCESSING

Foodera Technologies brings together Kiremko, Idaho Steel, Reyco Systems, Tummers and Van der
Giessen, five leaders in food processing with more than 100 years of combined expertise.

After more than 20 years of close collaboration, we are now united under one name, combining our
capabilities to deliver more for food producers around the world.

Together, we drive performance further through smarter engineering, deeper insight and integrated
solutions that continuously improve yield, uptime and operational efficiency.

Built to be the trusted heart of food processors worldwide.
**Built to lead.**

A future-proof way of working and living

Food production is evolving rapidly. Efficiency, sustainability and flexibility are no longer
optional, they define success. Foodera Technologies develops integrated solutions that help food
producers improve performance while preparing for future demands.

**Driving sustainable performance
**By combing advanced engineering with intelligent process design, we reduce waste, optimize energy
use and improve production consistency. Our solutions support more sustainable operations while
maintaining the highest standards in food safety, hygiene and reliability.

**Focused on long-term partnerships
**We work alongside you, from first concept to ongoing optimization. This collaborative approach
ensures every operation continues to perform and adapt, built to lead not only today, but in the
years ahead.

Solutions for every potato product

From fries and chips to flakes and specialty products, each end product requires a specific process
approach. As Foodera Technologies, we translate your product requirements into integrated solutions
that deliver consistent quality, efficiency and reliable output.

**Tailored to your production goals
**By combining expertise across Foodera Technologies, we design solutions that match your capacity,
process and market needs. Each line is engineered to perform and built to lead in your specific
application.

# BUILT TO LEAD

[ Discover what we do best ][20]
WE SHAPE YOUR FUTURE
IN POTATO PROCESSING

Foodera Technologies brings together Kiremko, Idaho Steel, Reyco Systems, Tummers and Van der
Giessen, five leaders in food processing with more than 100 years of combined expertise.

After more than 20 years of close collaboration, we are now united under one name, combining our
capabilities to deliver more for food producers around the world.

Together, we drive performance further through smarter engineering, deeper insight and integrated
solutions that continuously improve yield, uptime and operational efficiency.

Built to be the trusted heart of food processors worldwide.
**Built to lead.**

A future-proof way of working and living

Food production is evolving rapidly. Efficiency, sustainability and flexibility are no longer
optional, they define success. Foodera Technologies develops integrated solutions that help food
producers improve performance while preparing for future demands.

**Driving sustainable performance
**By combing advanced engineering with intelligent process design, we reduce waste, optimize energy
use and improve production consistency. Our solutions support more sustainable operations while
maintaining the highest standards in food safety, hygiene and reliability.

**Focused on long-term partnerships
**We work alongside you, from first concept to ongoing optimization. This collaborative approach
ensures every operation continues to perform and adapt, built to lead not only today, but in the
years ahead.

Solutions for every potato product

From fries and chips to flakes and specialty products, each end product requires a specific process
approach. As Foodera Technologies, we translate your product requirements into integrated solutions
that deliver consistent quality, efficiency and reliable output.

**Tailored to your production goals
**By combining expertise across Foodera Technologies, we design solutions that match your capacity,
process and market needs. Each line is engineered to perform and built to lead in your specific
application.

# Potato Flakes

What is Potato Flakes?

Potatoes flakes or Instant mashed potatoes are potatoes that have been through an industrial process
of cooking, mashing and dehydrating to yield a packaged convenience food that can be reconstituted
by adding hot water or milk, producing an approximation of mashed potatoes.

Features: Low in cholesterol Hygienically processed Long shelf-life Specifications Bulk Density. 250

and frozen potato dishes (e.g. potato dumplings, croquettes, stuffed dumplings or noodles)
Ingredient for bread and bakery products Fish and meat coating Ingredient in snack and pellet
manufacture Packaging Poly lined HDPE woven sack having inner PE liner. One 20 container packs 480
sacks of 20.00 KGS each

# Potato Peels & Rejects

Potato Peels & reject can be processed and incorporated into animal feed formulation. potato waste
is an excellent energy source for cattle, it has energy value similar to corn & barley. Potato
provides 7.6% of Cruid Protine, Potato feed also increases milk output as it is rich in starch.

Peel waste can also be used as fertilizer in farming it added much-needed humus & organic matter, it
promotes root growth & counteracts soil compaction this sustainably improve the soil structure.

This can be also used as raw-material for vermicompost, it provides a worm with nutrition & hummus.

# What Are Potato Flakes ?

The potato flakes are conserved form of potato and can be conveniently used as a substitute for
boiled potato. The rehydration property of flakes is very good and the product looks like mashed
boiled potatoes. Potato flake is perhaps the most popular dehydrated potato product used.

# Fresh Potato


We collect fresh potato from the trusted sources to ensure optimum product quality, these
potatoes are harvested under strict quality control and stored in high-tech cold storages to stable
the various parameters and these also ensure round the year supply to our manufacturing facility. We
carefully select our potatoes, so that potato flakes quality remains constant.

# Washing


Once potatoes reach the facility, they passed through metal detectors and then it is washed with a
high-pressure jet which removes dirt and foreign material. This makes inspection easy for damaged
potatoes, rotten potatoes and undersize potatoes. This all are removed before they enter into the
processing line.

# Peeling

After washing &  inspection potatoes are peeled by peelers, to remove the upper skin of potatoes,
After peeling they once again washed to remove peel waste. This potato peel waste is used in
cattle feed as they have rich nutritional value.

# Boiling

After peeling potatoes are cut in the desired size by high-tech cutters and then enters into
specially designed cookers for cooking. This cooking is done with high-pressure steam. To make sure
potatoes cooked evenly without losing any nutrients, no water used during the entire process.

# Mashing

Cooked potatoes are then passed through mashers, this masher mash the cooked potatoes in
fluffy mass. Additives are added at this point which ensures the long shelf life of the product in
the natural condition.

# Drying

Mashed potatoes are then enters into industrial high-tech dryers, this dryers evaporate the moisture
from the mash and form the flakes of potatoes. These flakes are then ground to obtain the desired
particle size.

# Fresh Potato


We collect fresh potato from the trusted sources to ensure optimum product quality, these
potatoes are harvested under strict quality control and stored in high-tech cold storages to stable
the various parameters and these also ensure round the year supply to our manufacturing facility. We
carefully select our potatoes, so that potato flakes quality remains constant.

# Washing


Once potatoes reach the facility, they passed through metal detectors and then it is washed with a
high-pressure jet which removes dirt and foreign material. This makes inspection easy for damaged
potatoes, rotten potatoes and undersize potatoes. This all are removed before they enter into the
processing line.

# Peeling

After washing &  inspection potatoes are peeled by peelers, to remove the upper skin of potatoes,
After peeling they once again washed to remove peel waste. This potato peel waste is used in
cattle feed as they have rich nutritional value.

# Boiling

After peeling potatoes are cut in the desired size by high-tech cutters and then enters into
specially designed cookers for cooking. This cooking is done with high-pressure steam. To make sure
potatoes cooked evenly without losing any nutrients, no water used during the entire process.

# Mashing

Cooked potatoes are then passed through mashers, this masher mash the cooked potatoes in
fluffy mass. Additives are added at this point which ensures the long shelf life of the product in
the natural condition.

# Drying

Mashed potatoes are then enters into industrial high-tech dryers, this dryers evaporate the moisture
from the mash and form the flakes of potatoes. These flakes are then ground to obtain the desired
particle size.

# Potato Flakes

Potato flakes are shorted with particle size and density and then packed in 25 Kg. of paper
bag lined with food grade virgin plastic packing to keep moisture away.

### About us

[>]

In a surprisingly large part, our reality consists of calculable problems. Should I buy or rent?
What's my ideal calorie intake? Can I afford to take this loan? How many lemonades do I need to sell
to break even? Often, we don't solve these problems because we lack knowledge, skills, time, or
willingness to calculate. And then we make bad, uninformed decisions. Omni Calculator is here to
change all that:

We are working on technology that will make every* calculation-based problem trivial for anyone to
solve.

[Read more about us][16]
*

within reason

## Most popular calculators

[

### p-value Calculator

The p-value calculator can help you find the p-value and evaluate how compatible your data is with
the null hypothesis.

Statistics][17][

### Confidence Interval Calculator

The confidence interval calculator finds the confidence level for your data sample.

Statistics][18][

### Test Grade Calculator

With this test grade calculator, you'll quickly determine the test percentage score and grade.

Other][19][

### Log Calculator (Logarithm)

The log calculator (logarithm) calculates the value of a logarithm with an arbitrary base.

Math][20][

### Sales Tax Calculator

Sales tax calculator works out the tax imposed on the sale of goods and services.

### Significant Figures Calculator – Sig Fig

Perform mathematical operations on significant figures with our calculator. Get step-by-step
solutions or use the built-in sig fig counter!

Math][22][

### Scientific Notation Calculator

The scientific notation calculator converts decimals into scientific notation. Explore the rules of
scientific notation for a thorough understanding.

Math][23][

### Square Footage Calculator

Utilize our free square footage calculator to determine the area of diverse property shapes in
square feet (sq ft) accurately and effortlessly.

Construction][24][

### Percentage Increase Calculator

Percentage increase calculator calculates the increase of one value to the next in terms of percent.

Math][25][

### Exponent Calculator

The exponent calculator helps you find the result of any base raised to a positive or negative
exponent.

Math][26][

### Percentage Calculator

Use our free online percentage calculator for precise results. Learn how to calculate percentages or
get quick answers with us.

Math][27][

### Square Root Calculator

Square root calculator helps you find the square root of any positive number.

Math][28][

### Circumference Calculator

Use this free circumference calculator to find the area, circumference and diameter of a circle.

Math][29][

### Slope Calculator

Calculate the slope of a line from two given points using the slope calculator. Discover the slope
formula and learn how to find a slope with two points.

Math][30][

### Salary to Hourly Calculator

Find your hourly wage instantly with our Salary to Hourly Calculator. Ideal for job seekers and
employees to convert annual, monthly, or weekly salaries.

Finance][31][

### Pythagorean Theorem Calculator

The Pythagorean theorem calculator helps you find out the length of a missing leg or hypotenuse of a
right triangle.

Control of temperatures during f… [READ MORE][142] [cca26bd7-8eb3-47ef-9570-c35b2924cc5c] #### [Beyond Sunflower Oil: A Technical Guide For Artisan Chip Producers][143] 23rd June 2026 Frying oil selection determines oxidation rate, finished product shelf life, flavor stability, fryer cleaning frequency, filtration load, acrylamid… [READ MORE][144] ## AGRO UPDATES [Young,Blonde,Woman,Scientist,Holding,Sample,Of,Potato,With,Tweezers] #### [Hutton Launches Potato Virus Testing Service After SASA Withdrawal][145] 21st July 2026 Hutton Scientific Services has launched a commercial potato virus testing service for the 2026 seed campaign, moving to fill a gap created by the w… [READ MORE][146] [Olivet,,France,-,15,Mars,2021,:,Crop,Irrigation,System] #### [UK Potato Sector Calls for Water to Be Treated as Strategic Infrastructure][147] 21st July 2026 Britain’s potato industry has called for water supplies for agriculture to be treated as strategic national infrastructure, warning that unreliab… [READ MORE][148] ## STORAGE SPECIAL [[storage_n]][149] #### [New Field-Based Strategies Help Reduce Storage Losses From Black Dot In Potatoes][150] 14th April 2026 A decade-long research effort led by Phillip Wharton at the University of Idaho is providing potato growers with updated management strategies to a… [READ MORE][151] [[Potatoes_Storage_n]][152] #### [San Luis Valley Study Highlights New Dry Rot Threats For Potato Storage][153] 10th March 2026 A new study published in the journal Plant Disease has identified several Fusarium species responsible for potato dry rot in Colorado’s San Luis … [READ MORE][154] [[The non-renewal of CIPC in the European market has left a huge gap in the potato storage spout suppression market, so growers must start looking for alternatives for their potato crops. One option comes from, Restrain, the residue-free, ethylene gas company. Being aware of the potential for CIPC’s non-renewal, Restrain made significant investments in the business, enabling the company to increase its manufacturing capacity at its production facility in the Netherlands and therefore ensuring it has the capacity needed to fill the gap left by CIPC. Restrain’s generators have been used for potato storage for over 14 years and are fitted with sensors which maintain a stable, low-level of ethylene, which is vital for the safe storage of potatoes. The generator has 20 liter fuel capacity, so daily filling is not required unlike other catalytic generators and Restrain generators use a unique start-up mechanism that ensures the best possible outcome when storing potatoes. “Through our determination to create a world-class product we completely re-designed our machines, taking the manufacturing in house to improve machine quality and investing heavily in the development of our sensor technology. This means our new B100 and B200 generators require limited annual maintenance and are fully calibrated before leaving our site, making them ready to use straight away,” said Dirk Garos, global sales director at Restrain. Following a series of a successful variety of trails, Restrain technology has recently been adopted by the global potato processing sector. The sector, which has traditionally used CIPC and other storage chemicals, has seen a global trend towards more sustainable, chemical-free solutions, so Restrain meets these requirements and just at the right time. “Seeing that the processing sector might need alternative solutions to CIPC, we invested in multiple processing variety trails to ensure that we have robust data for processing customers. Our results show that fry colors are preserved, there is no need for a delay between storage and processing and the potatoes are completely residue-free,” explained Garos. Most importantly, Restrain is priced in line with CIPC, making it one of the most cost-effective alternatives available. In addition to this, customers do not need to pay for the machines themselves, which are supplied free of charge, with customers only paying a fee on a per tons basis for the crops they are storing.]][155] #### [Van Iperen To Distribute Restrain Accumulator In The Netherlands][156] 23rd December 2025 Restrain, a specialist in residue-free technologies for potato production and storage, has appointed Van Iperen BV as the distributor of its Accumu… [READ MORE][157] ## PB PLAY ### PB PLAY ## POTATO BUSINESS DOSSIER * [Archive][158] [Subscribe][159] ## LATEST EVENTS [[©Klaas Eissens_Potato Europe 28-08-25 2mb-3]][160] #### [Digital Technologies and Live Demonstrations Set the Agenda for PotatoEurope 2026][161] 14th July 2026 [[3b07f906-52b0-49f6-9a60-8c8997c591e7]][162] #### [Heat and Control to Showcase Urschel Slicing and Dicing Technologies at foodpro 2026][163] 6th July 2026 [[Interpack]][164] #### [interpack Moves to June and Six-Day Format for 2029][165] 6th July 2026 ## INTERVIEWS [[vlam]][166] #### [Key Business Outlooks 2026: Katrien De Nul, Promotion Manager Potatoes at VLAM][167] 22nd February 2026 [[elea]][168] #### [Key Business Outlooks 2026: Stefan Toepfl, Managing Director of ELEA Technology][169] 22nd Janua

production cost.

type potato chips seasoning machine is very popular while for large potato chips production, the

## Useful tips you should know

## 01.

### Fully automatic frozen fries processing craft

For industrial production of frozen french fries automatically, the producer should set an entire
fries plant with a series of french fries making machines which include washing and peeling machine,
slicer machine, blanching machine, frying machine, de-watering and de-oiling machine, quick freezer,
packaging machine and auxiliary equipment.

## 02.

### semi-automatic french fries production line

Based on the full-automatic frozen fries line, the semi-automatic french fries production line will
be more flexible with labor working. Due to less investment costs, this semi-automatic fries line is
very suitable for investors and small food processing plants in the early days of business.

## 03.

### fully automatic potato chips processing line

The processing technology of potato chips and fries is very similar, but there are some different
processing steps. For example, when making potato chips, we use a potato cutter to slice the
potatoes evenly (2mm). You can also use different cutters to make wavy potato chips. In addition,
after the potato chips are fried, we can use an automatic seasoning machine to season the potato
chips. The operation of the automatic potato chip production line is very intelligent, which can
save a lot of labor costs and high production efficiency.

## 04.

### semi-automatic potato chip making

The semi-automatic potato chip processing line eliminates a lot of automatic conveying equipment.And
the blanching machine and the fryer in the semi-automatic potato chip production line can use the
same equipment, as well as the dehydrator and deoiler, which can save a part of the investment cost
and is more suitable for small and medium food processing plants with low investment budget.

## 05.

### Fried banana chips production line knowledge

The fried banana chip production line also has automatic and semi-automatic production equipment.
The processing capacities of the production line can be matched with different equipment according
to customer needs. The production process of fried banana chips mainly includes peeling, slicing,
frying, de-oiling, seasoning and packaging.

ABOUT XION

We are Xion Biotech Co., Ltd., (The company name was changed to Dingwei Biotech Co., Ltd. Trading
name: DinWeys in 2024) a large-scale potato flakes and mashed potato manufacturer, as well as the
supplier for Pepsi, Orion, and other brands, headquartered in Hebei, China.

For over a decade, we have specialized in developing and customizing potato flake products. We have
a fully certified food production factory and a product development and testing laboratory. Our high
level of production processes and quality is confirmed by the FSSC 22000, FDA, ISO9001, Halal,
Kosher certificates, and the TR CU 021 Declaration of Compliance.

Our product is suitable for potato chips, snacks, fast food, baking home cooking, etc. 

We own our potato planting base and boast top-notch production lines for potato flake powder and
flavored mashed potato processing. We offer high-quality potato flake powder raw materials and a
variety of flavored and customized instant mashed potato products.

Currently, several flavored instant mashed potato products are selling well in the domestic Chinese
market, being popular items on e-commerce platforms such as Taobao and Pinduoduo. Additionally, our
products have been exported to multiple countries, with our customized flavored instant mashed
potato products being sold in catering and supermarket channels across various regions.

As one of the top factories in China engaged in the export of customized instant mashed potato
products, we provide customers with:

The highest quality products
Flexible customization and development solutions
Competitive purchasing prices
Comprehensive service

Spanish Conquistadors conquered Peru, discovered the flavors of potato, and brought them back to
Europe.

## Quality & Process Excellence

Controlled processes designed to meet international food standards.

### Washing

Raw potatoes are thoroughly cleaned to remove soil and surface impurities.

01

### Peeling

Automated peeling ensures a clean, uniform base for consistent output.

02

### Cooking

Controlled cooking optimizes texture, taste, and functional performance.

03

### Mashing

Cooked potatoes are mashed into a smooth, uniform base for drying.

04

### Drum Drying

Potato mash is evenly dried on heated drums to create consistent sheets.

05

### Flaking

Dried sheets are converted into flakes with a stable, uniform structure.

06

### Sieving

Flakes are screened to achieve controlled particle sizes for applications.

07

### Metal Detection

## Suppliers

Raw Material Suppliers

dairy.

– Ingredient suppliers offering spices, flavors, additives, and other components.

Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Companies producing packaged food and beverages for distribution and sale.

Packaging Material Suppliers

Manufacturers and distributors of packaging materials, including labels, and packaging solutions.

Equipment Providers

Manufacturers and suppliers of food processing machinery, kitchen equipment, and packaging
machinery.

Commodity Traders

Traders dealing with commodities like grains, spices, oils, and other raw materials.

Wholesalers and Distributors

Wholesalers selling products to supply to retailers or other businesses in the food and beverage
sector.

## Buyers

Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Companies sourcing raw materials and ingredients for the production of packaged food and beverages.

Restaurants, Hotels and Catering Services

Businesses in the foodservice industry looking for bulk ingredients, finished products, equipment,
and supplies for their operations.

Wholesalers and Distributors

Distributors sourcing products to supply to retailers or other businesses in the food and beverage
sector.

Retailers and Grocery Chains

Supermarkets, grocery stores, and other retail chains seeking a variety of products for their
shelves.

Importers and Exporters

Businesses involved in the import and export of food and beverage products, ingredients, and
commodities.

Food Service Equipment Buyers

Companies looking to purchase kitchen equipment, machinery, and other related items for their
foodservice operations.

Packaging Material Buyers

Businesses in need of packaging solutions, including containers, labels, and other packaging
materials.

# 60+ Years of Excellence

Wyma Solutions is a global leader in post-harvest handling equipment with over 60 years of
experience. We design and manufacture complete processing lines for fresh produce operations in more
than 50 countries. Our equipment supports a wide range of crops, with particular strength in root
vegetables such as potatoes, carrots, onions, and other fresh produce. Customers choose Wyma for our
proven engineering, practical innovation, and deep industry experience. We focus on delivering
reliable, easy-to-maintain equipment that improves product quality, reduces waste, and maximises
throughput—helping growers and processors get the best value from every harvest.

# 60+ Years of Excellence

Wyma Solutions is a global leader in post-harvest handling equipment with over 60 years of
experience. We design and manufacture complete processing lines for fresh produce operations in more
than 50 countries. Our equipment supports a wide range of crops, with particular strength in root
vegetables such as potatoes, carrots, onions, and other fresh produce. Customers choose Wyma for our
proven engineering, practical innovation, and deep industry experience. We focus on delivering
reliable, easy-to-maintain equipment that improves product quality, reduces waste, and maximises
throughput—helping growers and processors get the best value from every harvest.
